content: Hiberix® is specifically indicated for active immunization as a booster dose to prevent invasive diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b. This vaccine is approved for administration in children aged 15 months through 4 years, prior to their fifth birthday. Hiberix is intended to be used as a booster dose in children who have already completed a primary vaccination series with a Haemophilus b conjugate vaccine that is licensed for primary immunization. It is important to note that Hiberix is not approved for use as a primary immunization vaccine. The effectiveness of Hiberix as a booster dose was evaluated based on immune responses in children, using serological endpoints that are predictive of protection against invasive diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b.
